limits: Package-local definitions override pinned core for inheritance only. Other packages are not silently installed to satisfy external references.
Templates, role variants, stations, missile and detachable components remain identified resources, not duplicate canonical ships.
Model hash groups exact files, not proof of equivalent hulls when models differ or same mesh is scaled.
Numeric fields retain source units and engine defaults are separate; script changes can override dictionary values.
Only factual parameters and bounding boxes retained. No copied models, textures or dialogue.
